summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ATR-based stop loss feature. All core functionality working correctly - ATR defined in indicator_registry.py with params=['period'] and operators=['atr_multiple'], backend accepts strategies with stop_loss_type='fixed' (default) and 'atr_multiple' with stop_loss_atr_period, frontend Risk step (step 7 of 7) shows Stop Loss Type dropdown with Fixed Percentage and ATR Multiple options, selecting ATR Multiple shows ATR Multiple input, ATR Period input (default 14), and helper text, strategy summary correctly shows ATR-based SL format (e.g., '2x ATR(14)'), and explainStrategy.js correctly formats ATR-based stop loss in text output.
passed_tests: Backend health endpoint (200 OK)
ATR indicator defined in indicator_registry.py with params=['period'] and operators=['atr_multiple']
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with stop_loss_type='fixed' (explicit)
POST /api/strategy defaults stop_loss_type to 'fixed' when not specified
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with stop_loss_type='atr_multiple' and stop_loss_atr_period=14
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with custom ATR period (21)
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with ATR multiple stop loss + ADX filter
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with high ATR multiple (5x ATR(20))
GET /api/strategies returns list including ATR stop loss strategies with correct data
Frontend Risk step (step 7 of 7) shows 'STOP LOSS TYPE' dropdown
Stop Loss Type dropdown has 'Fixed Percentage' option (default)
Stop Loss Type dropdown has 'ATR Multiple' option
Selecting 'Fixed Percentage' shows 'STOP LOSS (%)' and 'TAKE PROFIT (%)' inputs
Selecting 'ATR Multiple' shows 'ATR MULTIPLE' input with helper text 'e.g., 2 = 2x ATR distance'
Selecting 'ATR Multiple' shows 'ATR PERIOD' input with default value 14
Selecting 'ATR Multiple' shows 'TAKE PROFIT (%)' input
Strategy Summary correctly shows ATR-based SL format (e.g., 'SL: 2x ATR(14) / TP: 5%')
explainStrategy.js correctly formats ATR-based stop loss as 'Stop loss at Xx ATR(period).'
My Strategies page displays ATR stop loss info in strategy descriptions
Full E2E: Created strategy with ATR multiple stop loss (2.5x ATR(20)) and verified it saved correctly
seed_data_creation: Created 9 test strategies via pytest with various ATR stop loss configurations (fixed and atr_multiple types)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ATR-based stop loss feature fully implemented and tested. Backend RiskManagement model has stop_loss_type (fixed/atr_multiple) and stop_loss_atr_period fields. Frontend StrategyBuilder Risk step (case 6) has Stop Loss Type dropdown that toggles between Fixed Percentage and ATR Multiple UI. explainStrategy.js formats ATR stop loss as 'Stop loss at Xx ATR(period).' In-memory storage - data resets on restart.
